home.heroTitle: Prepare for BCS with a system that
home.heroSubtitle: Study → Practice → Analyze → Improve. BCS Compass tracks every answer, detects weak topics, and builds a revision plan around your real progress.

home.step2Text: Answer MCQs with instant feedback and clear explanations.

home.step5Text: Target weak areas and retest. Measure the change.

home.aiSubtitle: Paste or upload your notes. BCS Compass extracts exam-relevant facts, generates questions, and answers questions about your own material.
